predictions.status: Frozen before C1 execution; subjective prior forecasts, not estimates from C1 data.
predictions.purpose: Estimate within-task same-revision noise and screen gross bug-fix regression before protocol/peer-count inference.

aa.comparison: base3_A - base3_B; labels have identical treatment

bug_fix.comparison: base3_A - orig within ledger block only
bug_fix.claim: Gross-regression screen; no assertion of equivalence or reliability from three pairs.

predictions.saturation_rule: For each task, exclude from confirmatory score/noise/effect inference if first exec calibration score.rate > 0.95; retain and report all jobs. Exactly 0.95 is retained. Missing/invalid/leaked calibration is inconclusive, not evidence of suitability.

budget.interpretation: 189M is the scheduler fixed-per-job estimate; 203.7792M is model mean forecast. Actual observed spending governs later admission. Neither is an upper bound.

predictions.deferred_C2: After C1 noise/saturation analysis: preregister at least three reps each of exec, solo, 1, 2, 3 peers on a suitable long task, all murmur arms base3; use MURMUR_ONE_PEER_PROTOCOL=1 for peers=1. Fifteen jobs; three jobs remain contingency. This is a plan, not authorization to execute unregistered C2 jobs.
predictions.model_source: research/MODEL.md; numeric predictions use the frozen Phase-B model, checked independently in the C1 notebook.

subjective_80pct_run_intervals.interpretation: Marginal prior predictive ranges for individual runs, not simultaneous coverage, fitted confidence intervals, or guarantees. Cap-clipped time forecast is administrative; capped runs remain censored.

analysis_plan.pooling: No cross-task pooling of score or noise; report all runs, task/arm mean and sample SD; six base3 runs/task describe common treatment, three A/B paired differences/task describe paired noise.
analysis_plan.aa_contrast: A minus B for score; log(A/B) for positive time and token measures, summarize geometric mean ratios plus raw arithmetic means/SD; delivery discordances reported individually. No independent-treatment claim from artificial labels.
analysis_plan.bug_pairing: Exactly three ledger blocks, base3_A versus orig only. Never count base3_B as another independent comparator.
analysis_plan.score_noninferiority: One-sided 95% paired-t lower bound mean(A-orig)-2.919986*sd/sqrt(3) > -0.05 required for provisional score noninferiority; three complete eligible pairs required; strong normality assumption explicitly retained.
analysis_plan.cost_noninferiority: For active_min/input/uncached separately, one-sided 95% paired-t upper bound on mean(log(A/orig)) plus 2.919986*sd/sqrt(3) must be < log(1.25); complete positive uncensored eligible pairs required. All three endpoints must pass for provisional cost noninferiority.
analysis_plan.gross_regression: Any base3_A nondelivery while its orig delivers, confirmed new P0, mean paired score < -0.05, or any geometric mean cost ratio >1.25 flags investigation. Threshold crossing is a practical screen, not proof of causality.
analysis_plan.decision: If gross-regression trigger occurs, investigate and require preregistered follow-up before promoting further changes. Otherwise noninferiority bounds passing permits provisional no-large-regression statement for measured endpoints only. If bounds fail, state inconclusive. Never claim equivalence or delivery reliability from n=3.
analysis_plan.small_sample_uncertainty: Show paired values and assumption-dependent two-sided 95% t intervals (df=2, multiplier4.302653); exact two-sided sign-flip minimum p=.25 for n3. No .05 exact significance claim; bootstrap cannot create information.
analysis_plan.calibration: All first three jobs are exec calibrations. Exclude tasks with calibration rate >.95 from confirmatory score/noise/effect inference, but retain full descriptive rows and costs; do not substitute a task, change tests, or rerun jobs in C1. Invalid/missing/leaked calibration is inconclusive and task is ineligible until fresh preregistered calibration.
analysis_plan.leaks: Exclude leak_hits>0 runs from confirmatory contrasts, retain and flag in raw/descriptive tables; show full scheduled-set sensitivity. No unregistered replacements.
analysis_plan.missing: Nondelivery remains delivery=0 and observed valid score (often0); retain time/tokens when available. Missing scorer/telemetry stays missing; never impute zero cost or null mutation. Report reason and scheduled/eligible counts. Missing paired endpoint makes that pair unavailable, with no replacement.
analysis_plan.censoring: Retain timeout/cap outcomes and delivery/score. Mark time-to-delivery right censored; no cost/speed noninferiority conclusion from complete-case deletion of capped or failed deliveries. Report observed consumption separately.
analysis_plan.rate_limits: Report lines_429 by block and arm; primary scheduled analysis includes them, sensitivity reports clean complete blocks only. No regression adjustment with n3 and no causal attribution of all stalls to protocol.
analysis_plan.forecast_check: Compare all eligible run outcomes to frozen marginal ranges, report signed errors (score) and log ratios (positive time/tokens), mean errors and interval coverage separately by task/arm and pooled base3 treatment. Individual misses are diagnostics; a task/treatment mean outside its run range or empirical base3 dispersion outside its prior range falsifies that specific working prediction, without claiming a calibrated hypothesis test.
analysis_plan.C2: Select or recalibrate suitable long task after C1, preregister protocol/peer curve with >=3 reps/arm and concurrent paired blocks of at most3; preserve actual budgets and describe limits if saturation or budget prevents all comparisons.
